text:
Predatory ants -- a beneficial insect group.

Description: ant colonies include queens, workers, and soldiers, with winged reproductive forms appearing seasonally for mating flights. Workers, the most numerous caste, forage for food including live prey; some ant species are effective predators of many pest insects, particularly eggs, small larvae, and nymphs.

Role: conserving predatory ant populations in the field (for example, by avoiding broad-spectrum insecticide use that would also kill them) supports natural pest suppression as part of an IPM approach.
